outcome: Use of immediate postpartum long-acting reversible contraception (IPP LARC)
Composite measure of postpartum permanent contraception and IPP LARC use within 7 days of delivery
cohort: 1,729,663 Medicaid recipients who delivered from 2016 to 2018 in 16 states in the United States
finding: While there were racial and ethnic disparities in the use of IPP LARC alone, the overall use of highly effective inpatient contraception (IPP LARC or postpartum permanent contraception) was similar across racial and ethnic groups.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was examined as a factor contributing to disparities in contraception use, but specific findings related to mode of delivery were not reported.
